NewsArticle.Title: Arena Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content:
Thank you for your feedback on the new player-controlled Coliseum, already one of the most feature-rich arena systems in all online RPGs.
I have enhanced and improved everything possible at this time:
- New arena hosts. No applications accepted now. News will be sent when applications are accepted.
- Stronger Arena Host control of which spectators and combatants may enter through a more secure Gauntlet.
- Better Arena Host control of battle area gates.
- Separate spectator preparation room.
- Resurrection at Entrance mundane.
- Better communication in Team Selection room.
- Temporary protection of Loures Battle Ring combatants upon entry.
- Great Sleep Trap duration decreased for more exciting battles.
- Arena host banishment correction.
Be aware that you must remain logged in if you die until you can resurrect. Sgrios' hunger is insatiable.
